suspended.title: This tenant is suspended
suspended.description: Its jobs and its sign-ins are paused. Only the provider can open its pages until it is resumed.

deleting.title: This tenant is being deleted
deleting.description: Its data is being removed. Nothing can be changed any more.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}?
suspend.description: Backups and the other jobs of the tenant stop, and its members can no longer sign in. Nothing is deleted. You can resume the tenant at any time.

resume.title: Resume {name}?
resume.description: Jobs run again and the members can sign in again.

danger.title: Delete tenant
danger.description: Deleting the tenant removes its backups, its archive and its keys for good. This cannot be undone.
danger.internal: This is your own organisation. It cannot be deleted while it is marked as such.

enrol.title: Add a machine
enrol.description: Each machine gets a one-time install command that is valid for 24 hours. The machines themselves, with their status and readiness, are under Servers & endpoints, Inventory.

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: How long mail stays in the archive before it may be deleted.

retention.unlimitedHint: Archived mail is kept until it is removed by hand.
retention.end_of_year: The period ends on 31 December of the year the mail was received, plus the years above.
retention.from_capture: The period counts from the day the mail was captured.
retention.fixed: {scope, select, organisation {Your organisation uses this period in this version.} other {Every tenant uses this period in this version.}} Choosing another one is planned.

capture.title: Capture and journal address
capture.description: How mail gets into the archive, the journal address for Exchange Online, its rotation and the guide for the connector are on the Archive page. They are part of the daily archive, not of the settings.
